📖 Controls & Co-op Guide

🖥️ Desktop Controls

  • A / D or ← / → : Move Left / Right
  • Space / W : Jump (Press again to Double Jump!)
  • Shift : Dash / Evade
  • J or Left Click : Primary Attack
  • K or Right Click : Special Class Skill
  • E : Interact (Lever, Chest, Talk, Door)
  • ESC : Pause / Menu

📱 Mobile Controls

On smartphones & tablets, on-screen responsive touch controls will appear automatically with a virtual D-pad and large action buttons.

🤝 Cooperative Tasks:

• Pressure Plates & Gates: One player holds down a pressure plate while the other crosses.

• Dual Levers: Pull ancient levers together to open grand barrier doors!

• Boss Battles: Coordinate aggro, dodge telegraphed attacks, and revive at glowing Crystal Checkpoints.
